description: Return extractive quotations with citations and source provenance from verified public sources. The first 3 calls are free, total, with no signup and no claim header. The allowance does not reset. Free calls include web discovery when no source URLs are given.

depth.description: Research depth: 'brief' ($0.10, >=2 sources) or 'deep' ($0.25, >=3 sources). Default is 'brief'.

domains_filter.description: Optional list of domains to filter discovery.

source_urls.description: Public source URLs supplied by the caller. Brief requires >=2 distinct verified URLs; deep requires >=3.

topic.description: The topic, entity, or research query to synthesize.

name: synthesize_intelligence
